scope: Final main manuscript DOCX visual QA only; no source manuscript, exporter or numerical results were modified.
method: All 18 authoritative release2 PNG pages were actually inspected using view_image at original resolution (1414 x 2000).
DOCX XML inspected for native OMML, table row counts and font sizes, drawing count and paragraph borders.

PyMuPDF checked all PDF text-span and image bounding boxes against physical page bounds and checked for Unicode replacement characters. Automated geometry supplements the actual visual inspection and is not claimed to be a complete collision detector.

Introduction and methods prose readable with normal continuation.
Equations (1)-(3), five display lines, and inline symbols readable without clipping.
Equation (4), one display line, and inline mathematical symbols readable.
Methods and uncertainty prose fit; continuous-SOC expression readable.

Table 3 has four data rows and complete note; timing and memory columns remain distinct.
Figure 2, all four panels and complete caption, readable without clipping or text-line collisions.

Figure 3, all four panels and complete caption, readable without clipping or text-line collisions.
Figure 4, all four panels and complete caption, readable without clipping or text-line collisions.

resolved_findings.issue: Earlier rendered Table 1 omitted Panel 2, Panel 3 and Held-out rows despite their presence in DOCX XML.
resolved_findings.resolution: release2 page 7 actually displays all four data rows, caption and note. Verified visually.

resolved_findings.issue: Boundary-correction expression previously left a closing parenthesis alone at the next line.
resolved_findings.resolution: release2 page 6 displays the complete expression as one native OMML object; verified visually.

resolved_findings.issue: Earlier blue paragraph border and raw inline mathematical markup.
resolved_findings.resolution: No paragraph borders remain in document or styles XML; all pages visually show the corrected appearance and mathematical notation.
All five tables now appear completely on single pages: 7, 8, 9, 11 and 15. Tables 1, 2 and 4 retain all four data rows.

other_observations: Four figures occupy pages 8, 10, 12 and 13. No observed clipping, text-line collisions or unreadable labels at the reviewed page scale.
Four numbered display equations occupy six display lines; 18 native OMML objects are present in total, including inline mathematics.
All 37 references are present and visually readable on pages 16-18.
Whitespace associated with keeping tables and figures together is acceptable and does not require another revision.
limitations: This PASS applies to the exact DOCX hash and the release2 PDF/PNG rendering recorded here; another Word version or print driver may paginate differently.
Scientific numerical agreement is covered by the prior independent 441-check manuscript audit and was not rerun during this visual-only task.
